text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Romania's press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- The State Ownership Fund will negotiate with Omnimpex Chemicals the sale of 51 percent of Azomures fertiliser maker.
- The Defence Ministry will pay $1.34 billion for the purchase of 96 attack helicopters to be co-produced with Bell Helicopter Textron in Romania.
- Romania's aircraft industry is confronted with shortage of orders.
- The government plans to cut taxes in the farming sector.
- Trade unions warn further price hikes might trigger labour unrests.
- The National Oil Company plans to cut 200 jobs as part of its restructuring plan.
- Bakeries and mills are affected by shortage of funds.
